name: Donkey Kong Country: Forbidden Fruit
summary:
An extreme Kaizo-style ROM hack of Donkey Kong Country, created by TheScarletDevil.
Designed for veteran players and speed runners, the hack completely overhauls the base game's levels, bonus rooms, and boss encounters. Stages are rebuilt into high-difficulty obstacle courses that require frame-precise platforming, strict enemy manipulation, and the execution of advanced movement glitches - such as super jumps - to progress. In keeping with its title, the hack subverts standard gameplay expectations by turning traditionally helpful collectibles, power-ups, and stage elements into lethal traps and hazards.
